admin.aborted_banner: Restore was aborted. This shop stays in maintenance until you resume or turn maintenance off.
admin.backups_hint: Nightly copies of the database. For one now: GitHub → Actions → backup → Run workflow.
admin.delete_offer: Export the shop first if you still need a copy.
admin.delete_progress: Status is deleting. The nightly job removes rows. This page updates until the shop is gone.
admin.delete_warning: Deleting revokes devices now. The nightly job removes rows and files. Encrypted backups keep a copy for 30 days (daily), 12 months (monthly) and 90 days (GitHub). Deleting does not shorten that.
admin.err_budget: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
admin.err_not_operator: This account cannot open the operator console.
admin.import_bad: This file is not a bikri-unsynced export.
admin.import_hint: Revoked devices only. Choose the bikri-unsynced JSON file.
admin.import_not_revoked: Import only for a revoked device of this shop.
admin.import_tenant_mismatch: This file is from a different shop.
admin.maintenance_banner: This shop is in maintenance. Its tills get a maintenance error and keep selling offline.
admin.maintenance_off_body: Tills can sync again. An unfinished restore stays incomplete.
admin.owner_email_hint: Add this address in Cloudflare Email Routing destination addresses so the owner can verify it.
admin.pin_done: PIN reset. Only the hash was sent.
admin.pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
admin.pin_reminder: Confirm the owner’s identity out of band before you reset the PIN.
admin.pin_weak: This PIN is too easy to guess.
admin.reason_body: Write why you are changing this shop. It is stored in the shop’s activity.
admin.restore_aborted: Restore aborted. The shop stays in maintenance.
admin.restore_bad_zip: This zip is not a Bikri export.
admin.restore_different_zip: This zip is not the one this restore started with.
admin.restore_intro: Choose an export zip of this shop. Steps: maintenance on, purge, import, restore point, maintenance off. You can resume after a reload. Abort leaves the shop in maintenance.
admin.restore_need_file: Choose the same export zip to continue.
admin.restore_stuck: Purge did not shrink. The shop stays in maintenance.
admin.restore_wrong_shop: This export is for a different shop.
admin.revoke_body: The till stops syncing and shows the enrol screen. Other shops are not affected.
admin.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3–30 characters.
admin.slug_invalid: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
admin.support_body: The shop sees a banner until this ends. The code works once.
admin.support_end_body: End support access now? The shop banner goes away.

admin.usage_today_hint: Database size, writes and reads against the free-tier limits
admin.by_status_hint: Every shop by its current status
admin.needs_attention_hint: Backups, daily budgets and sync conflicts
admin.conflicts_hint: Sync conflicts waiting for the owner
admin.new_subtitle: Create a shop and enrol its first device
admin.new_details_hint: These details appear in the operator console and the shop’s records.
admin.new_side_1: The shop, its main branch and expense categories are created.

admin.new_side_3: The owner enrols one admin device with the code or link.
admin.new_side_4: Add the owner’s email in Cloudflare Email Routing so they can verify it.
admin.created_hint: The shop is ready. Its pairing code is shown only once.
admin.tenant_status_hint: State, reason and who changed it
admin.tenant_actions_hint: Status, support access and pairing codes
admin.tenant_usage_hint: Rows written over the last seven days
admin.history_hint: Every status change with its reason and time
admin.status_since_never: Status has not changed since the shop was created.
admin.devices_subtitle: Devices and codes for this shop
admin.issue_code_hint: A code enrols one device into this shop and expires after 72 hours.
admin.pin_subtitle: Replace an owner PIN without seeing the old one
admin.export_intro: Download this shop’s complete data as a ZIP file.
admin.export_hint: The file is built in your browser and recorded in the shop’s audit log.
admin.delete_zone_hint: Deleting a shop cannot be undone.

admin.backups_empty_hint: The first backup appears after the nightly schedule or a manual workflow run.
